declared_framework.machine_checkable_note: This sub-block is the part of the declaration the engine can confront with the computation. It SELECTS the basis generator and is then re-measured off the arrays that generator actually built; any disagreement raises FrameworkMismatch and no receipt is sealed. The free-text keys below are prose for a reader and are never trusted.
declared_framework.geometry: pseudo-Riemannian manifold with a symmetric non-degenerate metric g, its Levi-Civita connection, and the Riemann curvature tensor
declared_framework.concomitant_class: polynomial in the Riemann tensor and its covariant derivatives, with constant coefficients, contracted with g and its inverse
declared_framework.conservation_motivation: the matter stress tensor is divergence-free, so whatever geometric tensor is equated to it must be divergence-free identically
declared_framework.provenance: EVERY item in this block was DECLARED by the operator. None of it was discovered by the search. The search derives only what these declarations force.
not_declared_and_therefore_derived: which contraction patterns survive at a given derivative order
the dimension of the coefficient space after each constraint
that the divergence-free space in d = 4 at order 2 is exactly two-dimensional
that it is spanned by R_mn - (1/2) R g_mn and g_mn
the value of the constant the Newtonian limit fixes
that the Gauss-Bonnet combination contributes nothing in d = 4 and one extra dimension above it

arithmetic.sample_count_rationale: The scalar-carrier terms of the order-4 basis -- g_mn, R g_mn, R^2 g_mn, R_ab R^ab g_mn, R_abcd R^abcd g_mn and box R g_mn -- all share the same tensor structure at the base point, so each metric jet contributes exactly one independent constraint to that six-dimensional block. Six samples is therefore the hard floor and nine carries the margin. Every reported dimension is stable from seven samples upward, and the sampling error is one-sided in any case: too few samples can only report the surviving space too LARGE.

searches.purpose: the headline: what four dimensions, two derivatives, symmetry and conservation force
deliberately wrong constraint set: drop divergence_free and the space must grow
relax derivative_order from 2 to 4 in d = 4; the higher-curvature families must appear
five dimensions at order 4: Gauss-Bonnet must appear as an additional divergence-free contribution
six dimensions at order 4: the same additional contribution, confirming it is a d > 4 effect and not a d = 5 accident
